Калий.about: Potassium lowers blood pressure, more so in hypertensive patients, but the relationship is U-shaped: with excess potassium, pressure, on the contrary, increases.
Калий.caution: Excess potassium increased blood pressure in patients on antihypertensive drugs; for cystinuria, hydration and alkalization without graduation are recommended.
Калий.course: RCTs in MA lasted from 4 weeks; the optimal period is not specified in the abstracts.
Калий.dosage: In MA the range is 30-140 mmol/day; Specific dosage regimens are not given in the abstracts.
Калий.food_sources: Bananas, potatoes, beans, spinach and dairy products; in the pool, potassium is considered both as food and as a supplement in doses of 30-140 mmol/day.
Калий.guidelines: For cystinuria (2021): hydration, diet and alkalization; statements are not graded due to low evidence. ESPEN 2022 - by consensus.
Калий.how_to_choose: The source is more important than dietary supplements: MA examined doses of 30-140 mmol/day, and self-administration is dangerous for blood pressure medications and kidney diseases.

interactions.note: in MA, an increase in blood pressure with high potassium excretion was observed only in patients on drug therapy

mechs: Dose-dependent relationship: reduction in blood pressure to a difference of 30 mmol/day, then the effect weakens
Decrease in systolic and diastolic blood pressure
U-shaped relationship: above ~80 mmol/day excretion, blood pressure increases, especially with drug treatment
Increase in blood pressure with excess potassium
The decrease in blood pressure from potassium is stronger in hypertensive patients and with high sodium intake
Greater effect in subgroups with hypertension
Калий.myths: “Potassium tablets = diet” - part of the data concerns high-potassium salt, not dietary supplements. “The more, the better” - an increase in blood pressure already with a difference in excretion above ~80 mmol/day. “Helps everyone” - stronger in hypertensive patients.

Калий.onset: Only RCTs lasting 4 weeks or more are included in the MA; a shorter course is not stated in abstracts.
